sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Oversensitive. Headache, with heat of face.
Acute pain in cheeks. Drawing in facial muscles. Pain
in temporal muscles, when opening the jaws. Pain in
articulation of jaw, in masseter muscles, as if fatigued
by chewing too much. Cramp-pain on the zygomatic
arch.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Piitter taste. Irresistible desire for coffee.
Pain from navel into sternum. Atonic dyspepsia. Belch-
ing, with cough. [Ambra.]

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Diarrhoea and colic. Tenesmus with soft
^ftool; chronic diarrhoea, with debility and loss of flesh.
Burning in anus.

ANGUST. VERA — ANILINUM — ANTFIEMIS NOBILIS 61

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Itching along back. Pain in cervical ver-
tebrae. Drawing in the neck. Pain in spine, at nape of
neck and sacrum, worse on pressure. Twitching and
jerking along back. Bends backward.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Stiffness and tension of muscles and
joints. Pain in limbs on walking. Arms tired and
heavy. Caries of long bones. Coldness of lingers. Pain
in knees. Cracking in joints.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Caries, very painful ulcers which affect the
bone.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Nux; Ruin, Mercur.;

(Tetanic spasms with undisturbed consciousness, worse
noise, liguids, paralyzed lower extremities.)
